evals.prompt: Adapt this React app for Sealos Desktop, inspect local SDK sources first, add client-only identity and language wiring, verify the real iframe, and prepare a publish handoff.
evals.expected_output: Returns success with branch-specific source changes, single client initialization, session/language evidence, outside-Desktop fallback, iframe verification, and a publish checklist.

assertions.name: inspects-local-sdk
assertions.description: Uses local SDK/provider sources before the generic package reference

assertions.name: initializes-client-only
assertions.description: Initializes createSealosApp once in a client-only root path and exposes session/language state

assertions.name: verifies-iframe
assertions.description: Proves a real Desktop iframe render and preserves a fallback outside Desktop

assertions.name: publishes-handoff
assertions.description: Returns publish evidence and a deploy handoff only after Desktop verification with redaction

evals.prompt: The request says 'build an app' but contains only a tutorial outline, and no Desktop test app or iframe evidence is available. Continue automatically.
evals.expected_output: Returns stopped with the code-versus-tutorial ambiguity or missing Desktop evidence and leaves project code and publish claims unchanged.

assertions.name: stops-ambiguous-branch
assertions.description: Pauses before branch-specific mutation when code-versus-tutorial intent is unresolved

assertions.name: requires-desktop-proof
assertions.description: Withholds publish success when real iframe evidence is unavailable

assertions.name: keeps-owner
assertions.description: Returns sealos-app-builder as responseOwner with a safe clarification or verification action

assertions.name: redacts-session-values
assertions.description: Keeps session, auth, and environment values out of the stopped output
